RemoteSession.title: RemoteSession
RemoteSession.description: Represents a live screen-sharing and remote-control session between two Android phones.

sessionCode.description: Formatted 9-digit session code shared between the two phones.

accessPin.description: 4-digit security PIN required to connect to the host phone.

hostUserId.description: Authenticated UID of the host phone user.

hostDeviceName.description: Model and OS name of the host phone being controlled.

controllerUserId.description: Authenticated UID of the controller phone user.

controllerDeviceName.description: Model name of the controller phone.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the remote control session.

latestFrameBase64.description: Base64-encoded compressed JPEG/WebP live screen frame from the host phone.

frameWidth.description: Width in pixels of the captured screen frame.

frameHeight.description: Height in pixels of the captured screen frame.

isCharging.description: Whether the host phone is currently charging.

networkType.description: Host phone network connection type and signal info.

ramUsageMb.description: Used RAM in MB on the host phone.

ramTotalMb.description: Total RAM in MB on the host phone.

storageFreeGb.description: Available internal storage in GB on the host phone.

activeAppName.description: Currently active foreground app or screen title on the host phone.

torchEnabled.description: Whether the host phone flashlight is currently on.

accessibilityEnabled.description: Whether the RemoteControlAccessibilityService is active on the host phone.

screenCaptureEnabled.description: Whether MediaProjection live screen capture is active on the host phone.

clipboardText.description: Shared clipboard text synced between host and controller phones.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

RemoteCommand.title: RemoteCommand
RemoteCommand.description: A touch gesture, global navigation command, hardware toggle, or chat message sent from controller to host.

sessionId.description: ID of the parent remote session.

hostUserId.description: Denormalized UID of the session host for fast local rule evaluation.

senderUserId.description: Authenticated UID of the user sending the command.

endXPermille.description: Normalized swipe end X coordinate in permille (0..1000).

endYPermille.description: Normalized swipe end Y coordinate in permille (0..1000).

payload.description: Optional text payload for chat messages, clipboard sync, or package names.

executed.description: Whether the host device has executed this command.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when command was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when command was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SavedDevice.title: SavedDevice
SavedDevice.description: A paired or recently connected phone saved in the user's quick-connect list.

sessionCode.description: 9-digit session ID of the paired phone.

deviceName.description: Friendly display name of the paired phone.

lastRole.description: Whether this phone was last used as Host or Controller.

/remote_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Active and historical live screen-sharing and remote-control sessions.

/remote_sessions/{sessionId}/commands/{c.description: Real-time queue of remote touch gestures, system navigation actions, and chat messages.

/users/{userId}/saved_devices/{deviceId}.description: User-scoped list of paired devices for quick one-tap reconnection.
